claim.scope_statement: Credit Heath-Brown’s theorem that at most two prime bases fail to be primitive roots at infinitely many primes, hence one of 2,3,5 succeeds infinitely often. Separately prove that if q≡1 mod4 and p=2q+1 are primes, then 2 is primitive mod p. Neither identifies a universal fixed base nor proves the target density.
